_doc: 檢驗檢體用語對照（受控詞彙）：檢體種類、採檢時機、容器、量、保存、運送。第四十九輪起供 /en/lab/ 使用。全部為機器初稿（machineTranslated），畫面上以「機器翻譯」提示標示；以中文正本與檢驗單位指引為準。要新增語言就在每個詞條加上語言代碼欄位。

2–8°C 冷藏，勿冷凍全血.en: Refrigerated at 2–8°C; do not freeze whole blood

2–8°C 冷藏；72 小時以上請 -20°C 以下冷凍.en: Refrigerated at 2–8°C; freeze at -20°C or below if longer than 72 hours

2–8°C 冷藏（72 小時以上 -70°C）.en: Refrigerated at 2–8°C (-70°C if longer than 72 hours)

下呼吸道檢體（痰液、氣管抽取液）.en: Lower respiratory tract specimen (sputum, tracheal aspirate)

出疹後 3 日以上 IgM 較敏感.en: IgM is more sensitive 3 or more days after rash onset

出疹後 5 日以上 IgM 較敏感.en: IgM is more sensitive 5 or more days after rash onset

出現黃疸或肝功能異常時.en: When jaundice or abnormal liver function appears

皮疹出現時，取 2 處以上不同部位.en: When the rash appears; sample 2 or more different sites

全血 5 mL 或血清 2 mL.en: Whole blood 5 mL or serum 2 mL

每 3–6 小時採 1 次，共 3 次.en: Collect once every 3–6 hours, 3 times in total

厚薄片各 2 片.en: 2 each of thick and thin smears

咳嗽 2 週內、未使用抗生素前.en: Within 2 weeks of cough onset, before antibiotics are used

室溫或冷藏運送.en: Transport at room temperature or refrigerated

病灶結痂時.en: When the lesion has formed a scab

病毒運送培養基（VTM）拭子管.en: Swab tube with viral transport medium (VTM)

乾冰或冷凍運送.en: Transport on dry ice or frozen

乾燥無菌拭子管（Dacron／rayon，勿用棉棒）.en: Dry sterile swab tube (Dacron/rayon; do not use cotton swabs)

乾燥無菌拭子管或 病毒運送培養基（VTM）拭子管.en: Dry sterile swab tube or swab tube with viral transport medium (VTM)

通報前後連續採檢，至少 1 套為清晨第一口痰.en: Collect serially around notification; at least 1 set should be the first sputum of the morning

無法自咳痰者.en: For patients unable to cough up sputum

無法取得糞便時.en: When a stool sample cannot be obtained

無菌血清分離管（紅頭或黃頭，無抗凝劑）.en: Sterile serum separator tube (red or yellow top, no anticoagulant)

無菌螺旋蓋管（加少量生理食鹽水）.en: Sterile screw-cap tube (with a small amount of normal saline)

無菌螺旋蓋管／血清分離管.en: Sterile screw-cap tube / serum separator tube

發病 3 日內最佳，重症通報時即採.en: Best within 3 days of onset; collect at once when a severe case is notified

發病 7 日內（以發病 1–5 日最佳）.en: Within 7 days of onset (best on days 1–5 after onset)

發燒時，未服抗瘧藥前.en: During fever, before antimalarial drugs are taken

腹瀉期間、使用抗生素前.en: During diarrhea, before antibiotics are used

頸背部皮膚切片（含毛囊）.en: Skin biopsy from the nape of the neck (including hair follicles)

糞便 5–10 g（約拇指大小）.en: Stool 5–10 g (about the size of a thumb)

EDTA 紫頭管或血清分離管.en: EDTA purple-top tube or serum separator tube
